author: maxvotek
description: Boxerbook remote MCP server: professional boxing schedule, results, boxer cards, WBC/WBA/IBF/WBO/The Ring/TBRB rankings and where to watch, plus per-bout features for fight models and sports analytics: weigh-ins, ages, layoffs, ratings, the Boxerbook win probability and the market odds consensus. Free, no key. https://mcp.boxerbook.com/mcp

tools.name: boxing_schedule
tools.title: Boxing schedule
tools.description: Upcoming professional boxing cards worldwide, grouped by card: date, start_utc (card start in UTC), venue, promoter, broadcasters by region, and each bout with both records going in, division, scheduled rounds, title, Boxerbook forecast (win probability) and market odds consensus when known; each card and bout with its boxerbook.com url. Answers "is there boxing tonight", "who is fighting this weekend", "what boxing is on" and "what time does the card start", asked in any language. when=today also keeps last night's cards that started under 6 hours ago. At most 60 bouts per answer, whole days first: a longer window comes back truncated with next_arguments (from_date) for the rest. Pass lang matching the user's language (en, es, ru or ja) so the page links match it.

tools.name: rankings
tools.title: Division rankings
tools.description: The top 15 of a division: the Boxerbook rating (default) or the latest list of a publisher (WBC, WBA, IBF, WBO, The Ring, TBRB), with records. Division by code (hea, wel, w_fea) or name (heavyweight, women's flyweight). Pound for pound: division p4p (or "pound for pound", pfp) gives the Boxerbook P4P top 25 of men, w_p4p (or "women's p4p") the top 15 of women, ranked by the Boxerbook rating (mu − 2·rd measured against the elite of the boxer's division; active within 18 months, 10+ bouts, 2+ quality wins in 36 months); only Boxerbook has a P4P list, no publisher's is stored. Pass lang matching the user's language (en, es, ru or ja) so the page links match it.

tools.name: gyms_near
tools.title: Boxing gyms near a place
tools.description: Boxing gyms and boxing clubs near a city, a ZIP or postal code, or the user's location: name, address, distance, the gym's own phone and website, Google Maps rating with its number of reviews, the programs its website names (kids / youth, women, boxing fitness, amateur, pro), federation club, notable boxers, a short description when one is written, and the boxerbook.com page of each gym and of its city. Answers "boxing gym near me", "where can I train boxing in Austin", "boxing classes for kids in Brooklyn", "best boxing gyms in Toronto", "boxing clubs in London" (the UK capital; London, Ontario is country CA) and "is there a boxing club near 10115", asked in any language. Give place (a city such as "Brooklyn", "Austin, TX" or "Manchester", a ZIP or postal code, a state or region, or a gym's name), or lat and lon when the user's location is known; need keeps the gyms with kids classes, women's classes, boxing fitness or competition boxing. A city lists its gyms with the most complete listings and the best-reviewed first, then the nearest around it; a point or a postal code lists them nearest first within radius_km. At most 20 gyms. The directory covers the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, Germany, France and Switzerland (about 13,000 gyms); elsewhere the answer is empty and says so. Pass lang matching the user's language (en, es, ru or ja) so the page links match it.

place.description: a city ("Brooklyn", "Austin, TX", "Toronto"), a ZIP or postal code ("11201", "M5V 2T6", "SW1A 1AA", "10115"), a state or region, or a gym's name; leave it out to search around lat and lon
